# Spectrum ROM editor oracle

Copied unchanged from Format198x `format198x-sinclair-zx-spectrum-bas` v0.1.3,
`tests/fixtures/rom-editor`. Source and capture method:
https://github.com/format198x/format198x/tree/format198x-sinclair-zx-spectrum-bas-v0.1.3/crates/format198x-sinclair-zx-spectrum-bas/tests/fixtures/rom-editor

These bytes were captured on 2026-09-26 by typing each source line into the
genuine 48K ROM through its keyboard, using @emu198x/zx-spectrum 0.4.0.
ROM SHA1: `5ea7c2b824672e914525d1d5c419d71b84a426a2`.
They were not generated by either tokeniser. No ROM bytes are included.

The browser TAP exporter and native source loader must preserve these same
stored bytes. The refused lines must fail before creating a tape.
